qe: Which Article of the Constitution deals with the 'Appointment of the Governor' by the President?
qh: संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद राष्ट्रपति द्वारा 'राज्यपाल की नियुक्ति' से संबंधित है?
e: Rajya ka Rajyapal (Governor) rashtrapati dwara niyukt (appointed) hota hai, aur is niyukti ka samvidhanik pravdhan Article 155 mein likha hai. Article 153 kehta hai ki har rajya ke liye ek Rajyapal hoga (ek hi vyakti do ya adhik rajyaon ka bhi Rajyapal ho sakta hai), Article 163 Rajyapal ke vivekadhikar (discretion) ke bare mein hai, aur Article 161 kshama-shakti (pardoning power) ke bare mein. Rajyapal ki niyukti mein chunav nahi hota - kendra sarkar (kendriya mantri-parishad) ki salah par rashtrapati unhe niyukt karte hain, aur wo rashtrapati ke pratinidhi ke roop mein rajya ke mukhya (chief executive) hote hain. Exam point: Rajyapal ki niyukti = Article 155 (rashtrapati dwara), Rajyapal ka pad = Article 153, kshama-shakti = Article 161.

qe: Who served as the 'First Governor' of Bihar after India gained independence in 1947?
qh: 1947 में स्वतंत्रता के बाद बिहार के 'पहले राज्यपाल' कौन बने थे?
e: Swatantrata ke baad 15 August 1947 ko Bihar ke pehle Rajyapal (Governor) Jairamdas Daulatram bane the - ve ek swatantrata senani aur vakaalat (law) ke kshetra se jude vyakti the. Sir Satyendra Prasanna Sinha British kaal mein Bihar-Orissa ke pehle bharatiya Rajyapal banaye gaye the (1919-21), Dr. Zakir Hussain Bihar ke Rajyapal (1957-62) rahe aur baad mein desh ke tisre rashtrapati bane, aur R.R. Diwakar 1962 se 1967 tak Bihar ke Rajyapal rahe. Ye prashna Bihar-specific hai, isliye sahi naam Daulatram hai; baqi teen naam galat kaal ya galat pad ke hain. Exam point: swatantra Bharat mein Bihar ke pehle Rajyapal = Jairamdas Daulatram (15 August 1947).

qe: The 'Pardoning Power' of the Governor is codified under which Article of the Constitution?
qh: राज्यपाल की 'क्षमादान शक्ति' संविधान के किस अनुच्छेद में दी गई है?
e: Rajyapal ki kshama-shakti (pardoning power) Article 161 mein likhi hai - ismein kshama (pardon), badlaav (commutation), chhoot (remission), aavasiya (respite) aur sthagana (reprieve) jaisi shaktiyan aati hain, jahan maut ki saza chhod kar kendra ke kanoon wale mamle rashtrapati ke paas (Article 72) jaate hain. Article 213 Rajyapal ke adhyadesh (ordinance) ke bare mein hai aur Article 163 vivekadhikar ke bare mein; Rajyapal apni kshama-shakti ka prayog mantri-parishad ki salah par karte hain, na ki court ke nirnay ke aadhar par. Exam point: Rajyapal ki kshama-shakti = Article 161; maut ki saza ke mamle mein Rajyapal ke paas koi shakti nahi (wo rashtrapati ke paas, Article 72).

qe: What is the maximum constitutionally permissible size of the Council of Ministers in Bihar?
qh: बिहार में मंत्रिपरिषद का अधिकतम संवैधानिक आकार कितना हो सकता है?
o: 15% of total Legislative Assembly seats (including CM)
e: 91th samvidhan sanshodhan (2003) dwara joda gaya Article 164(1A) kehta hai ki kisi bhi rajya mein mantri-parishad (Council of Ministers) ka aakaar (size) vidhan sabha (Legislative Assembly) ke kul sadasyon ki 15% se adhik nahi ho sakta, aur isse hisaab mein mukhya mantri (Chief Minister) bhi shamil hota hai; saath hi nyoontam (minimum) 12 mantri hona zaroori hai. Bihar mein vidhan sabha ke 243 halqaon (seats) par 15% hisaab se lagbhag 36 mantri ho sakte hain. 10% ya 20% wale vikalp samvidhan mein nahi hain, aur '35 ka fix aankda' bhi galat hai kyunki seema Assembly ke aakaar se judi hai, kisi ek aankde se nahi. Exam point: mantri-parishad ka aakaar = vidhan sabha ke kul sadasyon ka 15% (mukhya mantri samet), nyoontam 12 (Article 164(1A)).

qe: Under Article 213, what is the maximum valid duration of an Ordinance promulgated by the Governor if not approved by the Legislature?
qh: अनुच्छेद 213 के तहत राज्यपाल द्वारा जारी अध्यादेश की अधिकतम वैधता अवधि क्या होती है?
o: 6 weeks from the date of reassembly of the State Legislature
e: Article 213 ke anusaar Rajyapal ke adhyadesh (ordinance) ki aayu (life) adhiktam 6 mahine hoti hai agar vidhan mandal (legislature) dobara na baithe, aur agar vidhan mandal unke anumodan ke liye phir se baithta hai to adhyadesh sirf 6 hafte tak hi zinda rehta hai - us punah-samnvay (reassembly) ki taareekh se gan kar ke 6 hafte ke andar use kanoon (Act) mein badalna zaroori hai. Adhyadesh tabhi jaari hota hai jab vidhan mandal (ya dono sadan) satr (session) mein na ho aur tatkaal karyavahi ki zarurat ho; ye ek aakaalik (temporary) vyavastha hai, jaise rashtrapati ka Article 123.Vikalp '6 weeks from promulgation' galat hai kyunki ginti adhyadesh lagu hone se nahi, vidhan mandal ke punah baithe (reassembly) se shuru hoti hai. Adhyadesh ke sindhaant (principles) par samaya-samay par nyayalaya ki raay bhi aati rahi hai, aur adhyadesh ko sansad/rajya vidhan mandal dwara manzoori se badla jaana chahiye. Exam point: adhyadesh = vidhan mandal ke punah baithe (reassembly) se 6 hafte andar ratify nahi hua to khatm (Article 213); adhiktam aayu 6 mahine.

qe: Who administers the constitutional 'Oath of Office' to the Governor of Bihar?
qh: बिहार के राज्यपाल को पद की संवैधानिक शपथ कौन दिलाता है?
o: The Chief Justice of the Patna High Court (or senior-most Judge available)
e: Rajyapal ko shapath (oath of office) dilane wale ka sahaj (simple) niyam yahi hai ki rajya ke uchchatam nyayalay (High Court) ke Mukhya Nyayadhish (Chief Justice) ye shapath dilate hain; agar wo upalabdh na hon to us High Court ke sabse varishth (senior-most) nyayadhish ye kaum karte hain. Bihar mein ye shapath Patna High Court ke adhyaksh kaam karke dete hain (jab mahamahim/nyayadhish maujood ho). Rashtrapati, vidhayak mandal ke mukhya mantri ya nirvaachan (outgoing) Rajyapal koi Rajyapal ko shapath nahi dilate, kyunki ye rasmi (ceremonial) zimmedari rajya ke uchchatam nyayalay ke adhyaksh ki hai. Isi tarah Rashtrapati ko shapath Bhartiya uchchatam nyayalay ke Mukhya Nyayadhish dilate hain. Exam point: Rajyapal ki shapath = High Court ke Chief Justice ya senior-most judge (Bihar mein Patna HC ke Chief Justice).

qe: Article 167 of the Constitution defines which crucial governance mechanism?
qh: संविधान का अनुच्छेद 167 किस महत्वपूर्ण व्यवस्था को परिभाषित करता है?
o: Duties of the Chief Minister in furnishing information to the Governor
e: Article 167 Rajyapal aur mukhya mantri (Chief Minister) ke beech ka sarakari (governance) setu hai - iske anusaar mukhya mantri ka kartavya hai ki wo Rajyapal ko rajya ke prashasan (kaam-kaaj) aur vidheyakon (legislation) ki jankari dein, jo bhi jaankari Rajyapal maange wo upalabdh karayein, aur kisi aise mamle par jo mantri dwara tay nahi hua ho aur Rajyapal ke kehne par samiti (Council) ke saamne rakhein. Iske alava Rajyapal kisi mantri ke kaam ko samanvayit (coordination) karne ke liye kisi mantri ko aadesh (directions) de sakte hain. Rajyapal ke vivekadhikar (discretion) ke mamle mein bhi ye jaankari dena zaroori hai. Article 167 Rajyapal ki karyapalika shakti ko jaankari se jodta hai. Exam point: Article 167 = mukhya mantri ka kartavya Rajyapal ko jaankari dena aur samanvayit karyavahi karna.

qe: For what maximum continuous duration can a non-legislator serve as a Minister in the State Government?
qh: कोई व्यक्ति बिना विधानमंडल सदस्य बने अधिकतम कितने समय तक मंत्री पद पर रह सकता है?
e: Samvidhan ke Article 164(4) ke anusaar koi vyakti jo vidhan mandal (Assembly ya Council) ka sadasya nahi hai, wo bhi mantri ban sakta hai - lekin use mantri banne ke baad 6 mahine ke andar vidhan mandal ka sadasya banna padega, warna us samay se uska mantri-pad samapt ho jaata hai. Bihar mein bhi yahi niyam lagu hai, isliye aise mantri ko 6 mahine ke andar chunav jit kar ya upchnav (by-election) se aana padta hai. '1 saal' ya '3 mahine' wale vikalp galat hain; samvidhan mein 6 mahine ka samay saaf likha hai, aur is samay mein vidhan mandal ki satr (session) ka hona bhi zaroori hai taaki sadasya shapath le sake. Exam point: gair-vidhayak (non-legislator) mantri = 6 mahine ke andar MLA/MLC banna zaroori (Article 164(4)), warna pad samapt.

qe: Under Article 200, when a State Bill is reserved by the Governor for the consideration of the President, what happens to the Governor's subsequent role?
qh: अनुच्छेद 200 के तहत जब राज्यपाल किसी विधेयक को राष्ट्रपति के विचारार्थ आरक्षित करता है, तो उसके बाद राज्यपाल की क्या भूमिका रह जाती है?
o: Governor can veto the President's opinion
Governor must sign it within 14 days
Governor's active role ends, and subsequent decisions fall under Article 201 directly between President and Legislature
e: Article 200 ke anusaar jab Rajya koi vidheyak (bill) rashtrapati ke vichar ke liye aarakshit (reserved) kar dete hain, to uske baad Rajyapal ki bhoomika samapt ho jaati hai - vidheyak rashtrapati ke paas chala jaata hai aur Article 201 ke teht rashtrapati khud faisla karte hain (anumodan (assent), rok (withhold), ya vidhan mandal ko wapas bhejna). Yani aise mamle mein Rajyapal sirf ek 'daak-petika' (post office) jaisi bhoomika nibhaate hain - wo rashtrapati ki raay ko veto nahi kar sakte, Assembly bhangi (dissolve) nahi kar sakte. Reservation aam taur par un vidheyakon par hota hai jo kendra ke adhikar (jaise rajya ke uttar mantri) ya vyapak (national) mahatva se jude hon. Exam point: rashtrapati ke paas aarakshit vidheyak = Article 200/201 - uske baad Rajyapal ki nirnayak bhoomika khatm, sab kuchh rashtrapati ke haath mein.

qe: The Governor of Bihar acts as the ex-officio Chancellor for which category of universities?
qh: बिहार के राज्यपाल पदेन कुलाधिपति (Chancellor) के रूप में किन विश्वविद्यालयों का कार्यभार संभालते हैं?
e: Bihar ke Rajyapal rajya ke vishwavidyalayaon (universities) ke chhatrapati (Chancellor) ke roop mein ex-officio kaam karte hain - yahi unka paramparik samvidhanik rajya vivek hai, aur unke dwara rajya ke sarkari vishwavidyalayaon ke kulpati (Vice-Chancellor) ki niyukti, senat ki baithak aur digri (degrees) pradaan jaise kaam hote hain. Kendra ke vishwavidyalayaon (jaise central universities) mein Chancellor nahi hota, wahan rashtrapati 'Visitor' hote hain; private deemed universities ke apne niyam hote hain. Isliye ye shakti keval rajya ke 'State public universities' par lagu hoti hai, jinke liye rajya vidhan mandal kanoon banata hai. Exam point: Rajyapal = rajya ke sarkari vishwavidyalayaon ka ex-officio Chancellor (Bihar mein bhi), kendra ke vishwavidyalayaon mein rashtrapati Visitor.

qe: Under Article 164(1) proviso, which States were originally mandated to have a special Minister in charge of Tribal Welfare?
qh: अनुच्छेद 164 के तहत किन राज्यों में जनजातीय कल्याण मंत्री का होना अनिवार्य है?
o: Madhya Pradesh, Odisha, Chhattisgarh, and Jharkhand
Bihar, Uttar Pradesh, and West Bengal
e: Article 164(1) ke proviso mein aaj char rajyaon ke naam likhe hain - Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, Madhya Pradesh aur Odisha - jahan jan-janjaati (tribal) kalyan ke liye ek vishesh mantri (Minister in charge of tribal welfare) rakhna zaroori hai, jo SC aur picchdi vargon (backward classes) ka kaam bhi dekh sakta hai. Dhyaan rahe ki jab samvidhan bana tha (1950) tab is proviso mein Bihar, MP aur Odisha ka naam tha; 2000 mein Chhattisgarh aur Jharkhand banne aur 94th sanshodhan (2006) ke baad Bihar ko list se hata diya gaya aur do naye rajya jode gaye, isliye Bihar ke liye ab ye vishesh vyavastha laagu nahi hai. Exam point: Article 164(1) proviso ke aaj ke char rajya = Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, MP, Odisha; pehle list mein Bihar tha, 94th sanshodhan (2006) se hata.

qe: To which body is the State Council of Ministers collectively responsible under Article 164(2)?
qh: अनुच्छेद 164(2) के अनुसार राज्य मंत्रिपरिषद सामूहिक रूप से किसके प्रति उत्तरदायी होती है?
e: Article 164(2) ke anusaar rajya ki mantri-parishad (Council of Ministers) sammilit roop se (collectively) vidhan sabha (State Legislative Assembly) ke prati jawabdeh (responsible) hoti hai - yani sadan bahumat se sarkar ko gira sakti hai aur sarkar ko sadan mein bahumat barkarar rakhna hoga. Rajyapal ke prati mantri-parishad ki jawabdehi samvidhanik taur par nahi hai (Rajyapal salah lene ke liye hai), rashtrapati ya vidhan parishad bhi is jawabdehi ka markaz nahi hain. Bihar mein bhi mukhya mantri aur unke saathi vidhan sabha ke vishwas par hi kaam karte hain; vidhan parishad (Council) ki bhoomika samiksha (review) tak hi hoti hai. Exam point: mantri-parishad = vidhan sabha ke prati sammilit jawabdeh (Article 164(2)); vidhan parishad ke prati nahi.

qe: Who determines the salaries and allowances of the Chief Minister and other State Cabinet Ministers?
qh: मुख्यमंत्री और अन्य राज्य मंत्रियों के वेतन और भत्तों का निर्धारण कौन करता है?
e: Rajya ke mukhya mantri (Chief Minister) aur anya mantriyon ke vetan (salary) aur bhatte (allowances) rajya vidhan mandal (State Legislature) kanoon (law) banakar tay karta hai; jahan tak aisi vidhi na banayi gayi ho, wahan samvidhan ki anusuchi (Second Schedule) mein diye gaye pravdhanon ke anusaar bhog (payment) hota hai. Rajyapal kisi executive aadesh (decree) se vetan tay nahi kar sakte, na kendra ka grih mantralaya (Ministry of Home Affairs) ya Union Parliament is mamle mein rajya ke liye faisla karte hain. Yahi vyavastha rashtrapati, mukhya mantri, nyayadhish aur adhikariyon ke vetan ke liye bhi hai - sabhi ke liye 'kanoon dwara tay' ka sindhaant lagu hai. Exam point: mukhya mantri/mantriyon ka vetan = State Legislature dwara kanoon se tay (Article 164 + Second Schedule).

qe: What unique feature distinguishes the discretionary powers of the Governor from those of the President?
qh: राज्यपाल की विवेकाधीन शक्तियों को राष्ट्रपति की शक्तियों से कौन सी अनूठी विशेषता अलग बनाती है?
o: The President cannot act without Governor's permission
The Governor can declare national emergency at will
Governor's discretion is subject to prior approval from Parliament
The Constitution explicitly provides for constitutional discretion to the Governor under Article 163, whereas the President has primarily situational discretion
e: Rajyapal aur rashtrapati dono ke paas vivekadhikar (discretion) hota hai, lekin samvidhan ne Rajyapal ke liye Article 163 mein saaf-saaf 'constitutional discretion' likha hai - yani kuchh mamle samvidhan ne khud Rajyapal ke vivekadhikar mein chhod diye hain (jaise mukhya mantri ki niyukti jab koi dal sphat bahumat ke saath nahi ho, aise vidheyak par anumodan jahan mantri-parishad ki salah vivek ke bagair nahi, assembly bhang karne ka mamla). Rashtrapati ka vivekadhikar mukhya roop se 'situational' (sthiti-vishesh) hota hai - wo bhi mantri-parishad ki salah par chalta hai, lekina samvidhan mein uske liye 163 jaisa alag pravdhan nahi. Vikalp 'President cannot act without Governor', 'national emergency at will' ya 'Parliament ki purv-anumati' sab galat hain. Exam point: Rajyapal ka vivekadhikar = Article 163 (samvidhan mein spashth); rashtrapati ka vivekadhikar sthiti-vishesh (situational) hota hai.

qe: Under Article 166, all executive actions of the Government of a State are formally expressed to be taken in the name of:
qh: अनुच्छेद 166 के तहत राज्य सरकार के सभी कार्यकारी कार्य औपचारिक रूप से किसके नाम पर किए जाते हैं?
o: The Chief Secretary of the State
e: Article 166(1) ke anusaar rajya sarkar ke saare karyapalika (executive) karyavahi rashtrapati ke naam se nahi, balki Rajyapal (Governor) ke naam se ki jaati hain - yani aadesh, sanjha (notifications) aur nirnay 'Rajyapal ke naam se' jaari hote hain, aur unhe Rajyapal ke naam se pramanit (authenticated) karne ki vyavastha Rajyapal (Rules) banate hain. Isi tarah kendra mein Article 77 ke teht saari karyavahi rashtrapati ke naam se hoti hai. Mukhya mantri, mukhya sachiv (Chief Secretary) ya cabinet sachivalaya koi aadesh ke naam se nahi jaari karte - wo sirf niyam (rules) banakar karyavahi ko pramanit karte hain. Exam point: rajya ki karyavahi = Rajyapal ke naam se (Article 166); kendra ki karyavahi = rashtrapati ke naam se (Article 77).

qe: Under Article 217, who must the President consult while appointing Judges to the High Court of a State?
qh: अनुच्छेद 217 के तहत उच्च न्यायालय के न्यायाधीशों की नियुक्ति करते समय राष्ट्रपति को किससे परामर्श करना अनिवार्य है?
o: The Chief Minister and the State Law Minister
The Speaker of the State Assembly
The Advocate General of the State
The Chief Justice of India, the Governor of the State, and the Chief Justice of that High Court
e: High Court ke nyayadhishon ki niyukti mein Article 217 ke anusaar rashtrapati ko teen logon se paramarsh (consult) karna hota hai - Bhartiya uchchatam nyayalay ke Mukhya Nyayadhish (Chief Justice of India), sambandhit rajya ke Rajyapal, aur us High Court ke Mukhya Nyayadhish. Is 'consultation' ka matlab salah (advice) lena hai; kuchh mamlon mein uchchatam nyayalay ne isse 'collegium' vyavastha ke roop mein vikasit kiya hai. Mukhya mantri, vidhan sabha adhyaksh ya Advocate General is paramarsh ka hissa nahi hain, kyunki nyayapalika ki swatantrata (judicial independence) banaye rakhne ke liye ye teen hi sahayak (consultants) samvidhan ne tay kiye hain. Exam point: HC judge ki niyukti = rashtrapati, CJI + Rajyapal + us HC ke Chief Justice se paramarsh ke baad (Article 217).

qe: At whose disposal is the 'Contingency Fund of the State' placed under Article 267(2)?
qh: अनुच्छेद 267(2) के तहत 'राज्य की आकस्मिकता निधि' किसके अधिकार में रखी जाती है?
o: The Speaker of the Legislative Assembly
e: Article 267(2) ke anusaar rajya ki Aakasmik Nidhi (Contingency Fund of the State) Rajyapal ke aadhin (at the disposal of the Governor) rakhi jaati hai - is nidhi ka istemal un akasmik (unforeseen) kharchon ke liye hota hai jinke liye vidhan mandal se pehle anumati lena sambhav nahi hota; aise kharch ke baad vidhan mandal ki anumodan (approval) aur Article 204 wale vidheyak (Appropriation) ke through niyamit karana padta hai. Nidhi ka kosh (corpus) rajya vidhan mandal kanoon se tay karta hai. Vitta mantri, vidhan sabha adhyaksh ya mukhya mantri is nidhi ke niyantran ke adhikari nahi hain. Exam point: Contingency Fund of State = Rajyapal ke aadhin (Article 267(2)); akasmik kharch ke liye, baad mein vidhan mandal se anumodan zaroori.

qe: Under Article 174, who possesses the constitutional power to summon, prorogue the State Legislature, and dissolve the Legislative Assembly?
qh: अनुच्छेद 174 के तहत विधानमंडल के सत्र को आहूत करने, सत्रावसान करने और विधानसभा को भंग करने की शक्ति किसके पास है?
e: Article 174 ke anusaar rajya vidhan mandal (State Legislature) ko sammon (summon) karna, satr ko sthagit (prorogue) karna aur vidhan sabha ko bhangi (dissolve) karne ki shakti Rajyapal ke paas hoti hai - ye sab wo mukhya mantri ki salah par karte hain. Rashtrapati is mamle mein nahi aate (wo sansad ko sammon karte hain), mukhya mantri ke paas samvidhanik shakti nahi hai (wo sirf salah deta hai), aur adhyaksh (Speaker) sadan ke andar ki kaaryavahi chalate hain, sammon/bhangi nahi karte. Haan, prorogation ke baad punah sammon hote samay kam se kam 6 mahine ka antar nahi ho sakta (Article 174(1)). Exam point: vidhan mandal ki satr sammon/prorogue aur assembly bhangi = Rajyapal (Article 174), mukhya mantri ki salah par.

qe: What constitutional conditions of office are specified for the Governor under Article 158?
qh: अनुच्छेद 158 के तहत राज्यपाल के पद के लिए कौन सी संवैधानिक शर्तें तय की गई हैं?
o: Must have served as an active High Court Judge
Must be an elected resident of that specific state
Must not be a member of either House of Parliament or State Legislature, and shall not hold any other office of profit
Must retire at the age of 65 years
e: Article 158 Rajyapal ke pad ki shartein (conditions of office) batata hai - Rajyapal sansad ke kisi bhi sadan ya rajya vidhan mandal ka sadasya nahi ho sakta (agar hai to sadasyata chhodni padegi), aur wo koi anya 'office of profit' (laabh ka pad) nahi le sakta; iske alava unka vetan-bhata unke karyakal mein kam nahi kiya ja sakta. Rajyapal banne ki nyoontam aayu 35 saal hai (Article 157), par koi uchchatam aayu (retirement) ki seema nahi hoti, koi High Court judge ke roop mein kaam karne ki shart nahi hoti, aur us rajya ka nivasi (resident) hona bhi zaroori nahi hai. Exam point: Article 158 = office of profit ya vidhayak-sadasyata ki roshni nahi, vetan kam nahi hota; Rajyapal ke liye age limit 35 (minimum), residence ki shart nahi.

qe: What proportion of members can the Governor nominate to the Bihar Legislative Council (Vidhan Parishad)?
qh: बिहार विधान परिषद में राज्यपाल कुल सदस्यों के कितने भाग को मनोनीत कर सकते हैं?
e: Rajya Vidhan Parishad (Legislative Council) mein Rajyapal kuchh sadasyon ko naamit (nominate) karte hain - Article 171 ke anusaar ye naamit sadasya kul sadasyon ki 1/6 ke barabar hote hain, aur unhe saahitya, vigyan, kala, sahakari aandolan (cooperative movement) aur samaj-seva ke kshetra mein khaas gyaan (special knowledge) rakhne wale logon mein se chuna jaata hai. Bihar Vidhan Parishad mein 75 sadasyon ka pravdhan hai, isliye lagbhag 12 naamit sadasya hote hain. 1/12 aur 1/3 wale vikalp graduates/teachers aur sthaniya swaraj sansthaon ke chunav se jude hain, aur 'fixed 2 members' galat hai. Exam point: Rajyapal ke naamit sadasya = vidhan parishad ki kul sadasyata ka 1/6 (Article 171); Bihar mein 12 ke aas-paas.

qe: Under Article 233, who makes appointments, postings, and promotions of District Judges in a State?
qh: अनुच्छेद 233 के तहत राज्य में जिला न्यायाधीशों की नियुक्ति और पदोन्नति कौन करता है?
o: The Governor in consultation with the High Court exercising jurisdiction
e: Article 233 ke anusaar zila nyayadhishon (District Judges) ki niyukti, inka sthanaantar (posting) aur padonnati (promotion) Rajyapal (Governor) karte hain - niyukti ke liye Rajyapal High Court se paramarsh (consult) karte hain, aur sthanaantar/padonnati ke liye bhi High Court ki salah leni hoti hai. Lekin chhote mamlon (municipal/ civil judge jaise) ki niyukti High Court khud karta hai (Article 234) aur uske liye rajya lok seva aayog (Public Service Commission) ka bhi sahyog leta hai. Chief Justice of India, State PSC ya Law Department is chayan ka hissa nahi hain; nyayapalika (judiciary) ke niyantran mein rahne ke liye ye vyavastha banayi gayi. Exam point: District Judge = Rajyapal dwara niyukti + posting/promotion, High Court se paramarsh ke saath (Article 233).

qe: Under Article 356, on what basis can the President impose President's Rule in a State?
qh: अनुच्छेद 356 के तहत राष्ट्रपति किस आधार पर राज्य में राष्ट्रपति शासन लगा सकते हैं?
o: Only after an express resolution passed by the State Assembly
On receipt of a report from the Governor of the State or otherwise, when satisfied that the State government cannot be carried on in accordance with the Constitution
On the direct petition of the State High Court
e: Article 356 ke anusaar rashtrapati rajya mein 'Rashtrapati Shasan' (President's Rule) tabhi laga sakte hain jab Rajyapal ki report milne par ya anya tarike se unhe vishwas ho jaaye ki rajya ka prashasan samvidhan ke anusaar nahi chal raha; iske baad sansad ke dono sadanon ki manzoori se ye lagu rehta hai (aam taur par 2 mahine ke andar sansad se approve karwana padta hai, phir 6-6 mahine ke extension, kul 3 saal tak). Sirf vittiye aapatkal, rajya vidhan sabha ke resolution ya High Court ki yachika se Rashtrapati Shasan nahi lagta. S.R. Bommai case (1994) mein uchchatam nyayalay ne kaha ki ye shakti nyayik samiksha (judicial review) ke aadhin hai. Exam point: Rashtrapati Shasan = Article 356, Rajyapal ki report ya 'otherwise' vishwas + sansad ki anumodan (Bommai case: judicial review).

qe: Under Article 176, when is the Governor constitutionally required to deliver a 'Special Address' to the State Legislature?
qh: अनुच्छेद 176 के तहत राज्यपाल के लिए विधानमंडल में 'विशेष अभिभाषण' देना कब अनिवार्य है?
o: At the commencement of the first session after each general election to the Assembly and at the commencement of the first session of each year
At the end of every financial quarter
Only during joint sittings called to resolve legislative deadlocks
Whenever the Chief Minister tables a Money Bill
e: Article 176 ke anusaar Rajyapal vidhayak mandal ke dono sadanon (ya ek sadan wale rajya mein us sadan) ke samaksh 'Vishesh Abhibhashan' (Special Address) do maukon par deta hai - (1) aam chunav ke baad pehli satr ke aarambh mein, aur (2) pratyek varsh ki pehli satr ke aarambh mein. Is bhashan mein sarkar ki niti aur karyakram (policies/programs) ka ullekh hota hai, jise mantri-parishad taiyaar karta hai. Ye rashtrapati ke Article 87 wale abhibhashan ka rajya-stariya roop hai; harek financial quarter ke ant, deadlock wali sanmilit baithak ya Money Bill par alag se address nahi hota. Exam point: Rajyapal ka Vishesh Abhibhashan = chunav ke baad pehli satr + har varsh ki pehli satr (Article 176).

qe: Who serves as the official legal advisor to the State Government and represents it in High Court proceedings?
qh: राज्य सरकार का आधिकारिक कानूनी सलाहकार कौन होता है और उच्च न्यायालय में उसका पक्ष कौन रखता है?
o: The Advocate General of the State
e: Rajya sarkar ka aadhikarik vidhik salahkar (official legal advisor) 'Advocate General' (Mahadhivakta) hota hai, aur uski niyukti Rajyapal karte hain (Article 165) - wo rajya sarkar ki taraf se High Court mein mukadme lada karta hai, kanooni salah deta hai aur Rajyapal jab chahein unse salah le sakte hain. Advocate General rajya ka prathinidhitva karta hai, jaisa kendra mein Attorney General (Article 76) aur Solicitor General karte hain - ye dono kendra ke pad hain. Rajya ka kaanoon sachiv (Law Secretary) ek sarkari adhikari hota hai, Advocate General nahi. Bihar mein bhi rajya sarkar ke mukadme Advocate General hi High Court mein ladte hain. Exam point: rajya sarkar ka vidhik salahkar = Advocate General (Article 165, niyukti Rajyapal dwara); kendra ke liye Attorney General (Article 76).

qe: What happens to the State Council of Ministers if the Chief Minister resigns or passes away while in office?
qh: यदि मुख्यमंत्री अपने पद से इस्तीफा दे दें या उनका निधन हो जाए, तो मंत्रिपरिषद की क्या स्थिति होती है?
o: The Governor appoints a bureaucrat as caretaker head
The senior-most minister automatically becomes Chief Minister
The Council of Ministers continues to function normally for 6 months
The Council of Ministers automatically stands dissolved
e: Article 164(1) ke teht Rajyapal mukhya mantri ko niyukt karte hain aur mukhya mantri ki salah par anya mantriyon ko; isliye mukhya mantri ke istifa (resignation) dene ya nidhan (death) hone par poora mantri-parishad swatah (automatically) bhang ho jaata hai - naya mukhya mantri niyukt hone tak Rajyapal sareekhe aadesh (interim) karyavahi chalate hain. Isi karan nayi sarkar banne se pehle koi 'senior-most minister automatically CM' nahi ban jaata; ye mukhya mantri ka pad janta ke chune hue vidhayak bahumat (majority) ke bharose hota hai, na ki seniority ke. Kuchh samay ke liye 'caretaker' (karyavahi) mantri reh sakte hain, par wo nayi niti nahi bana sakte. Exam point: mukhya mantri ke istifa/death par mantri-parishad turant bhang (Article 164(1)); naya CM niyukt hote hi sadan ki sadasyata aadi ki shartein lagu.

qe: What special personal immunities are granted to the Governor of a State under Article 361 during their term of office?
qh: अनुच्छेद 361 के तहत राज्यपाल को उनके कार्यकाल के दौरान क्या विशेष व्यक्तिगत उन्मुक्तियां (Immunities) प्राप्त हैं?
o: Immune from any civil suits even after two months notice
Immune from any criminal proceedings or arrest warrants, and not answerable to any court for exercise of official powers
Immune from paying direct personal income taxes
e: Article 361 ke anusaar rashtrapati aur Rajyapal ko unke karyakal (term of office) mein bahut vyapak samrakshan (protection) milta hai - kisi bhi adalat ke saamne unki aadhikarik (official) shaktiyon ke prayog ke liye jawabdehi nahi hoti, unke khilaf karyakal mein koi aapraadhik karyavahi (criminal proceedings) ya grahan (arrest) nahi ki ja sakti, aur vyaktigat (personal) karya ke liye diwani (civil) karyavahi sirf 2 mahine ki purv-soochna (prior notice) ke baad hi ho sakti hai. Lekin ye chhoot aay-kar (income tax) bhugtan ya akhbaron (press) ki aalochna se nahi bachati - kyunki ye vyaktigat mamle hain aur aise mamlon mein ye aadi vyakti ke roop mein jawaabdeh ho sakte hain. Exam point: Article 361 = karyakal mein criminal karyavahi/arrest par rok, aadhikarik karya ke liye court ke saamne jawabdehi nahi, civil mamle mein 2 mahine ki soochna zaroori.

qe: Under Article 192, who decides questions regarding the disqualification of a sitting MLA or MLC (other than on grounds of anti-defection)?
qh: दल-बदल के अलावा, किसी विधायक या एमएलसी की अयोग्यता पर अंतिम निर्णय कौन लेता है?
o: The Governor, whose decision is final, but must act strictly in accordance with the opinion of the Election Commission
The Speaker of the Assembly alone
The State Cabinet in formal session
e: Article 192 ke anusaar kisi vidhayak (MLA) ya parishad sadasya (MLC) ki nirhrit (disqualification) ke sawaal ka nirnay Rajyapal karte hain - lekin ye kshmata apni marzi se nahi, balki nirvaachan aayog (Election Commission) ki raay (opinion) ke anusaar hi istemal hoti hai, jise 'binding' (baandhne wali) maana jaata hai; Rajyapal khud se faisla badal nahi sakte. Ye vyavastha MP ke liye Article 102 wale rashtrapati/faisle ki tarah hai (wahan bhi nirvaachan aayog ki raay binding hoti hai). High Court, vidhan sabha adhyaksh ya rajya mantri-parishad is sawaal ka antim nirnay nahi karte; anti-defection wale mamle mein alag se adhyaksh (Speaker) ka nirnay hota hai. Exam point: MLA/MLC nirhrit (anti-defection ke alava) = Rajyapal, nirvaachan aayog ki binding raay ke anusaar (Article 192).

qe: Can the Governor of a State independently remove the Chairman or members of the State Public Service Commission (BPSC)?
qh: क्या राज्य के राज्यपाल राज्य लोक सेवा आयोग (BPSC) के अध्यक्ष या सदस्यों को अपने स्तर पर हटा सकते हैं?
o: Yes, with the simple consent of the Chief Minister
Only through a vote of no confidence in the Assembly
No, they can only be removed by the President under Article 317 after an inquiry by the Supreme Court
Yes, because the Governor appoints them under Article 316
e: Bihar Lok Seva Aayog (BPSC) ke adhyaksh ya sadasya ki niyukti to Rajyapal karte hain (Article 316), lekin unhe hatane (removal) ka adhikar Rajyapal ke paas nahi hai - samvidhan ke Article 317 ke teht ye kaam keval rashtrapati kar sakte hain, aur wo bhi tab jab uchchatam nyayalay (Supreme Court) ki jaanch (inquiry) ke baad aisi grimaan (report) de ki unhe hataya jaaye (badaniyati (misbehaviour) ya nirjivata (insolvency) jaisi wajah se). Is tarah ke svatantrata (autonomy) kaaran unhone apni marzi se hataya nahi ja sakta - isse aayog ki nishpakshata (neutrality) bani rehti hai. Isi vyavastha ke saath rashtrapati bhi Union PSC ke sadasya ko hataate hain. Exam point: BPSC/PSC sadasya ki hataye (removal) = rashtrapati, Article 317 ke teht Supreme Court ki jaanch aur report ke baad; Rajyapal sirf niyukti karte hain (Article 316).

qe: Under Article 202, in whose name is the Annual Financial Statement (State Budget) presented before the State Legislature?
qh: अनुच्छेद 202 के तहत राज्य का वार्षिक वित्तीय विवरण (बजट) किसके नाम पर विधानमंडल में प्रस्तुत किया जाता है?
o: The Governor, who causes it to be laid before the House(s)
e: Article 202 ke anusaar rajya ka varshik vittiya vivran (Annual Financial Statement) vidhan mandal ke samaksh Rajyapal ke naam se rakha jaata hai - yani ye Rajyapal hi hote hain jo usse sadan ke saamne 'cause to be laid' karte hain (jaise kendra mein rashtrapati Article 112 ke teht karte hain). Is vivran mein sarkar ki aay aur vyay ka hisaab hota hai, aur iske baad grants ki maangi (Demands for Grants), Appropriation Bill aur vittiye vidheyak ki prakriya chalti hai. Mukhya mantri, vitta mantri ya CAG is vivran ko sadan ke samaksh nahi rakhte; CAG uski jaanch/audit karta hai aur apni report deta hai. Isliye prashna ka jawab Rajyapal hi hai. Exam point: rajya ka budget = Rajyapal ke naam se vidhan mandal ke saamne (Article 202), jaise kendra mein rashtrapati ke naam se (Article 112).

qe: How did the 104th Constitutional Amendment Act (2020) affect the composition of State Legislative Assemblies regarding nominated members?
qh: 104वें संविधान संशोधन (2020) ने विधानसभा में मनोनीत सदस्यों के संबंध में क्या बदलाव किया?
o: Made all nominated members eligible to vote in Presidential elections
Mandated proportional representation of tribal communities
Increased Anglo-Indian reservation to two seats
Abolished the Governor's power to nominate one Anglo-Indian member under Article 333
e: 104th samvidhan sanshodhan (2020) ne Article 333 ke teht Rajyapal ke us adhikar ko samapt kar diya jis se wo vidhan sabha mein Anglo-Indian samuday (community) se ek sadasya ko naamit (nominate) karte the - yani ab Bihar (ya kisi bhi rajya) mein aisi nomination nahi hoti. Isi sanshodhan ne Article 331 ke teht Lok Sabha mein Anglo-Indian ke 2 naamit sadasya ki vyavastha bhi hata di, aur SC-ST ke liye lok sabha/vidhan sabhaon mein aarakshan (reservation) 2030 tak badha diya. Isliye vikalp 'nomination badh gayi', 'tribal proportional representation' ya 'Presidential election ka vote' sab galat hain - ye sanshodhan nomination hata'ne se juda hai, badhane se nahi. Exam point: 104th sanshodhan (2020) = Lok Sabha ke 2 aur vidhan sabha ke 1 Anglo-Indian naamit sadasya ki vyavastha khatm (Article 331/333), SC-ST aarakshan 2030 tak.

qe: What happens if a Bill returned by the Governor for reconsideration is passed again by the State Legislature with or without amendments?
qh: यदि राज्यपाल द्वारा पुनर्विचार के लिए लौटाया गया विधेयक विधानमंडल द्वारा पुनः पारित कर दिया जाए, तो राज्यपाल के पास क्या विकल्प होता है?
o: The Governor must give assent to the Bill (cannot withhold or return it again)
The Governor can permanently veto it
The Governor can refer it to the Supreme Court
e: Article 200 ke anusaar agar Rajyapal koi vidheyak (bill) sadan ko 'punarvichar' (reconsideration) ke liye wapas bhejte hain aur sadan us vidheyak ko sanshodhan ke saath ya bina sanshodhan dobara paas kar deti hai, to Rajyapal ko us vidheyak par anumodan (assent) dena hi padega - wo use dobara rok nahi sakte ya wapas nahi bhej sakte. Haan, ek raasta bacha rehta hai: Rajyapal vidheyak ko rashtrapati ke vichar ke liye aarakshit (reserve) kar sakte hain (Article 200/201), jahan antim faisla rashtrapati ka hota hai. Isliye 'bill lap ho jaata hai' ya 'permanent veto' wale vikalp galat hain, aur Supreme Court ke paas bhejne ka koi samvidhanik pravdhan nahi hai. Exam point: punah paas kiya gaya vidheyak = Rajyapal ka anumodan zaroori (Article 200); sabse aakhri raasta rashtrapati ke liye aarakshan (reservation) hai.

qe: Under Article 163(2), if any question arises whether a particular matter falls within the Governor's discretion or not, whose decision is constitutionally final?
qh: यदि यह प्रश्न उठता है कि कोई मामला राज्यपाल के विवेकाधिकार में आता है या नहीं, तो किसका निर्णय अंतिम होता है?
o: The order of the President of India
The decision of the Governor in their discretion is final and cannot be questioned
The ruling of the Supreme Court of India
The decision of the State Legislative Assembly
e: Article 163(2) ke anusaar ye sawaal ki koi mamla Rajyapal ke vivekadhikar (discretion) mein aata hai ya nahi, is par Rajyapal ka nirnay antim (final) hota hai aur kisi bhi aadhar par sawaal nahi uthaya ja sakta - yani court bhi is tathya (fact) ki jaanch nahi karegi ki kya mamla vivekadhikar mein tha. Isi ke saath samvidhan ne saaf kiya hai ki jab Rajyapal samvidhanik vivekadhikar (constitutional discretion) ka prayog karte hain to wo mantri-parishad ki salah (advice) manne ke liye bandhe hue nahi hote. Rashtrapati ka aadesh, uchchatam nyayalay ki raay ya vidhan sabha ka nirnay is mamle mein antim nahi hota - antim nirnay Rajyapal ka hi hai, bhale hi us par aakalan ka kabhi vivad ho. Exam point: kya mamla Rajyapal ke vivekadhikar mein hai - nirnay antim Rajyapal ka (Article 163(2)), vivekadhikar mein mantri-parishad ki salah bandhne wali nahi.
